address: Building 9, Mamsha Al Saadiyat, Abu Dhabi
bio: Grab a seat at the counter of this contemporary Japanese restaurant to watch the chefs prepare your dishes over the robata grill. The ingredients are top-notch, and the kitchen is clearly motivated. The pared-back interior is very on-trend and comes complete with a sakura tree. People-watchers and anyone who enjoys a good sea view will prefer a seat on the terrace as this spot on Mamsha Al Saadiyat is hard to beat.
